title: Study on the expression of denitrification genes in antimony-containing wastewater
description: The study investigated the influence of antimony on sulfur-based autotrophic denitrification, tried to find a feasible way to remove nitrogen, phosphorus and antimony from textile wastewater simultaneously with pyrrhotite-sulfur-limestone composite material.
